meta.title: Get Notes Organizer
meta.description: Installed Cordis bundle: organize 得到大脑/Get笔记 via official OpenAPI. Full-text download into a unified data directory (default: data-getbrain next to the repo, auto-created, never in Git), read-only by default, confirmation-gated writes, double-gated deletion. Configure API Key/Client ID in the Settings → Getnote sidebar; changes apply immediately, no restart needed.
